Mivida Compound, Fifth Settlement, is a unique architectural experience offered by Emaar Development to its clients in Egypt. It is an integrated community offering all the comforts and luxury. Designed according to internationally recognized sustainability policies, Mivida Emaar is the first eco-friendly compound in New Cairo, inspired by the designs of California. 

Choosing New Cairo as your new home is the best choice. It is one of the best new cities in Egypt, and one of the most diverse and vibrant. It also enjoys a prime location, allowing it to be close to all the important areas of Cairo while simultaneously remaining quiet and away from the crowds. It is the city that brings together everything you need in your new apartment. 

Mivida New Cairo covers an area of ​​approximately 860 acres, with a large percentage of green spaces. Mivida New Cairo offers a variety of residential units, including standalone villas, apartments, studios, garden apartments, twin houses, and administrative offices, with different sizes to suit all needs, whether families, individuals, or companies. 

With a high level of professionalism, Emaar Misr for Urban Development has developed its Mivida New Cairo project, offering a wide range of distinguished services. Its location is in the heart of the city, adjacent to the best locations in the Fifth Settlement. In terms of amenities, Mivida Emaar features large green spaces, walkways, and artificial lakes, giving each unit a distinctive view. The Boulevard is also a global shopping area, offering a wide range of luxurious shopping, as well as entertainment and leisure facilities. 

##Real Estate Developer of Mivida New Cairo

The owner of Mivida New Cairo is Emaar Misr for Urban Development, a leading construction and urban development company in Egypt and the Arab world, with branches in many Arab countries, the United States, and Europe. 

Emaar Misr for Urban Development was established in Egypt in 1997 and has since become a key partner in some of the largest urban projects, becoming one of the most prominent real estate developers in the country. Emaar Misr for Urban Development has received numerous awards for its successive successes in residential and other projects, including the Golden Nugget Award for Best International Site Plan in 2015 and the Entertainment and Tourism Project Award for the Marassi project at the Cityscape Egypt Real Estate Awards in 2014. 

Emaar Misr is one of the most prominent companies with a prominent community role, particularly in addressing the housing crisis. In 2018, it launched the Beyout El Khair project, the first phase of which completed the renovation and rehabilitation of 1,000 housing units. The second phase has begun, renovating and rehabilitating additional units and assisting in income-generating projects in several new governorates. 

###Emaar Misr for Urban Development's Previous Projects

Emaar Misr for Urban Development has launched numerous luxurious projects in Egypt, through which it has gained customer trust and established itself as one of the most prominent real estate developers in Egypt in recent years. The company has numerous projects in Lebanon, the UAE, India, Morocco, and Pakistan. Among Emaar's most notable projects are:

Cairo Gate Compound, Sheikh Zayed. 
Uptown Cairo Compound, Mokattam. 
Marassi Village, North Coast. 
Mivida, Fifth Settlement. 

##Location of Mivida Compound, New Cairo

Mivida Emaar occupies a prime location on South 90th Street in the heart of the Fifth Settlement, New Cairo. This compound is located in an area distinguished by its proximity to the most important areas of life in New Cairo, making it an ideal destination for housing and investment. 

Mivida Compound, Fifth Settlement, is distinguished by its proximity to a large number of services and facilities in the area. It is close to leading schools and universities, making it an attractive option for families keen on providing a quality education for their children. Additionally, residents of Mivida Compound by Emaar can enjoy easy access to shopping malls, restaurants, cafes, and stores, adding convenience and quality to their daily lives. 

What makes Mivida Compound's location in the Fifth Settlement even more attractive is its proximity to the area's main roads and highways, making it easy for residents to reach their destinations quickly and conveniently. This makes commuting within the city convenient and efficient.
